title: Emoji Phrasal Verbs
description: Look at the emoji scene and choose the phrasal verb that completes each sentence.

questions.prompt: The plane will ___ in ten minutes.
questions.explanation: "Take off" means to leave the ground and start flying.

questions.prompt: I can't find my keys. Can you help me ___ them?
questions.explanation: "Look for" means to try to find something.

questions.prompt: My aunt ___ my baby brother when my parents work late.
questions.explanation: "Look after" means to take care of someone.

questions.prompt: We ___ gas on the highway, so we had to walk to the next town.
questions.explanation: "Run out of" means to have none of something left.

questions.prompt: It took me a whole week to ___ the flu.
questions.explanation: "Get over" means to recover from an illness or a bad experience.

questions.prompt: Please ___ the lights when you leave the room.
questions.explanation: "Turn off" means to stop a machine or light with a switch.

questions.prompt: It's freezing outside, so ___ your coat before you go!
questions.explanation: "Put on" means to start wearing a piece of clothing.

questions.prompt: I've decided to ___ chocolate for a month.
questions.explanation: "Give up" means to stop doing or having something, often a habit.
